views.text: In April 2026, Equity Mates said Pilbara Minerals just traded with lithium spot prices, implying results moved with commodity cycles rather than company-specific advantages.

views.text: In May 2024, Equity Mates outlined a structural case that rising lithium demand could attract supply and cap long‑term prices, likening it to oil where prices rose only about 2.5 times over a century despite massive volume growth, which mattered for miners like Pilbara Minerals.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Adam Keily with Scott Phillips - Qantas, Pilbara, Cochlear & more

views.text: In February 2025, a guest on Equity Mates noted Pilbara Minerals acquired Latin Resources and said they were not a fan of the deal from Pilbara Minerals’ perspective, highlighting capital allocation concerns.

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In February 2025, Equity Mates discussed Pilbara Minerals at $2.33, down 18% over six months, noting short interest had eased and some producers were removing supply to address an oversupplied lithium market.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Adam Dawes - Xero, Pilbara Minerals, Resmed & more

views.text: In June 2022, Equity Mates reported Pilbara Minerals fell 22% in a day as a broker called for lithium to drop from about US$60,000 a tonne to US$16,000 in 2023, saying the spot price had been trading like a forward‑looking equity.

episode.title: Lithium market meltdown: is the future cancelled?
